notes: Lifestyle piece D passes exit gate at 390px on live bundle index-CRokInQJ.js. Good-life board TOP shelf renders a true 2-col grid (156px 156px) of 5 small cards, each with a non-empty signal line. Both door cards ('Time for?', 'A day for you') open the in-board FaceOverlay dialog with correct titles and content and close cleanly via the Back arrow. The 'A small wonder' do-it card ticks in place to a sage-bordered 'Saved — it's in your planner' state with no navigation and no board movement. Bottom 'Permission & small joys' shelf intact; no horizontal overflow. All console errors are pre-existing baseline (User.me, App-not-found 404s, socket reject); no new ReferenceError/TDZ.
